quote: Homozygous deletion mutants of the entire cluster, single-gene mutants, and the Δddgs-/-;Δomt-/- and Δomt-/-;Δatpg-/- double-gene mutants did not produce mycosporines.
assay: homozygous deletion in the fungus (Phaffia rhodozyma UCD 67-385): the ddgs omt double mutant and the single-gene mutants make no mycosporines. Phenotype only: no intermediate is reported for this gene, and the sentence names ddgs in the double mutant only. The product of this reaction, demethyl-4-deoxygadusol is not named in the abstract, so the link is not T1a. The same abstract reports 4-deoxygadusol after expression of DDGS together with OMT in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. USER DECISION: T1a if that co-expression product is accepted as the assay of DDGS. Protein: GenBank WEV88679.1 of cluster OQ547787, which cites the paper.
